paragraphs: Beanstack is reading challenge software for public libraries. Schools and districts use it to run reading programs built on choice rather than quizzes.

Readers join a challenge, track progress, earn badges and mark milestones from any device. Libraries can start from ready-made challenge templates or build custom programs for their community. Logging tools include a reading timer, an ISBN scanner and progress bars for individual titles. Reporting goes down to the specific badges an individual reader earned. A feature called Beanstack Tandems links a reader's library and school accounts.

Challenge templates are developed with public library system partners including CSLP, iREAD, Page Turner Adventures and TD Bank. Client success managers help launch a site and stay on for ongoing support. The company describes thousands of libraries, schools, readers and students using the Beanstack app. A measure called the Reading Motivation Index is meant to show educators what drives students to read beyond minutes logged.

quote.text: Track and report on reading progress with real-time data and actionable insights right at your fingertips.
